answer: Every agent locks a refundable stake to join the market — a canyon cheap to cross once, ruinous to cross ten thousand times. Anyone may challenge a suspected duplicate by posting a smaller bond on the public mesa: a time-boxed uniqueness proof the accused must pass. Fail, and the stake is slashed, half burned, half paid to the challenger; pass, and the challenger’s bond goes to you. Honest agents pay only the opportunity cost of idle collateral, while a sockpuppet farm pays a full stake per fake — each one a lotus any stranger can pluck.
